utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning all, you alright? Let's get cracking, quick stand-up for Monday. Anything nasty from weekend shift before we go round?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Morning. Bit slow getting in, mind, traffic on the ring road was horrendous.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, same here, traffic on the ring road was an absolute car park.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: At least you got here warm. The heating in the portakabin is still useless, feels like a fridge in there.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Standard, that place. Right, lines are up though, mostly.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good stuff. I'll start then. For me, just so nobody raises it again, I already swapped the filter on the boiler safety valve yesterday, so that's done, not for today.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Nice one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: We've got a jam recurring on the long belt, so I'll clear the jam and check the sensors on the long belt this morning.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: That was sticky again on nights, yeah.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: It stopped us twice, only short ones but enough to annoy everybody.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah. And also, on the outfeed conveyor, the guarding wants checking. I'll check the guarding on the outfeed conveyor next week; that's holding production up so it needs doing first once we get into that slot.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Cheers boss, because ops are moaning about that one already.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: As long as they leave it as-is till you've looked, fine by me.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: From process side, nothing huge. I did see the pressure on the GT1 dip for a few minutes, it came back on its own, so just an observation at this stage, not asking for anything yet.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Any product effect?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: No, trend just sagged then recovered. I'll keep an eye on it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fine, log it and watch it.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Other one, the shutdown on the wrapper is cancelled now, production need it running, so that's not happening today.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, we've nicked that slot back, afraid so.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Saves a job, I suppose.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, wrapper cancelled, noted.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Mechanical-wise, no fresh breakdowns from me. The alarm box though, still no sign of the bits. I'll chase the purchase order for the alarm box today, fairly important because we're just waiting on stores and whoever's sat on the PO.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, good, thanks Davey.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: I'll grab purchasing after this.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: I was gonna ask about that, actually.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: From HSE, I signed off the inspection on the arm on two on Tuesday, so that's closed already.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: I also heard a slight rattle from the counterbalances, nothing to action yet, just worth keeping in the back pocket if it gets worse.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Alright, I'll listen out when I'm over there.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: And for today, I need the permit side tidied up on the cold unit. I'll do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the cold unit at half two.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: If we can get near it, yeah.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Half two works if production can free it.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Should be able to give you a window then, not before.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: That's fine, I'm saying at half two anyway.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. Mide, while we're on plant behaviour, can you investigate the pressure drop on the pump in the pit whenever you get a chance?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, alright, I can investigate the pressure drop on the pump in the pit whenever I get a chance. I've seen the trend wobble a bit.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Nice one.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Only blocker from me, I can't get to the cold unit until production gives us a window, so if anyone wants miracles before then, no chance.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, same story, mate.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood, cold unit only when we've got a gap.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Production side, we're running, but I can't get to the Line 2 Pick and Place Robot until production gives us a window, which sounds daft because I am production, but you know what I mean, there's no spare minute on Line 2 right now.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, everyone's production till summat stops.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Exactly.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Cal, on the monthly fire alarm test, can you do it?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: At half two?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, at half two ideally.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: I've got enough on. I won't get to that if you want me on the floor for changeover.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Right, fair.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Who can cover it then?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: No, sorry, let me rephrase — if it's literally at half two, I can take that one, because that's after the rush. I can run the monthly fire alarm test at half two.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Fine by me, cheers Cal.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, good, Cal's got the monthly fire alarm test at half two.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Was gonna say, if not I'd only be pressing buttons and upsetting everyone.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: That's basically the job, Tom.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: I know, glamorous.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Tomasz, anything from maintenance?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Mostly carry-ons. Greased up the usual offenders on nights. Nothing I'm putting in as a new job today. Long belt's the main nuisance but you've already got that, boss.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: If you want a hand when you clear it, shout.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Will do.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Mide, on that pump in the pit, if you see anything odd electrically just ping me, because if it's actually process demand changing I'd rather know before lunch.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, will do. Could just be impulse line muck, could be instrument drift, I'll have a look when I can get down there.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: It's always that pit. Everything down there either leaks or lies.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Or both.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Usually both.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before this turns into philosophy: key timings, Grace on the cold unit sign-off at half two, Cal on the monthly fire alarm test at half two.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Assuming we get the access window, yeah.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: You'll get it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Davey's chasing the purchase order for the alarm box, fairly important. Mide's looking at the pressure drop on the pump in the pit whenever he gets a chance.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And for me, I'll clear the jam and check the sensors on the long belt this morning, and I'll check the guarding on the outfeed conveyor next week; that's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Sounds good.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Anything else on safety before we break?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: No, apart from don't fiddle with that guarding till Sarah's been over it.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Message received.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: And if anyone's going near the pit, take a decent torch. Last one in there came back looking like a coal miner.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Cheers, Davey, really selling it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right then, crack on. Shout if anything changes.
